question: Which draws on the AI's generator are not made through MT19937Next.

struct_fields.name: ai_draws
struct_fields.comment: the loader sets it to zero when it has read `ai_seed` and seeded the generator, so it counts what has been drawn since. **It is the MT19937's index**, +0x9C0 from the generator at +0x124, which MT19937Next reads, advances mod 624 and stores - so it wraps at 624 and is no running count, whatever its name. Its readers in .text (a scan for the displacement, 2026-11-16): the constructor twice, CGameState::LoadKey's zeroing (0x2805A8), and CEU3AI_RankInvasionAreas' staging step (0x496F5A), whose inline copy of the draw is the generator's one draw not made through MT19937Next (FINDINGS-liveread.md, section 105).
struct_fields.evidence: MT19937Next (0x6A2B90-0x6A2BE4): reads [edi+0x9C0], increments, idiv by 0x270, stores the remainder. A capstone scan of .text for the displacement 0xAE4 finds four instructions: 0x27D1A6 and 0x27D73D in CGameState::CGameState, 0x2805A8 in CGameState::LoadKey, 0x496F5A in CEU3AI_RankInvasionAreas. Seen: with the staging draw logged at 0x496FBC every hour of a 48-hour recording has the index moving by exactly the draws logged.
struct_fields.revises: comment - it is the generator's index, and its readers
